**Unfinished: the protected delivery gate did not pass.** The run produced an unfinished diagnostic, not a final query or validation manifest. The diagnostic reports `critic_missing`; the current strategy still needs a fresh critic round and a successful `psb report`.

The current draft has **37,784 records** in the PubMed snapshot through **2020-11-22** (Entrez date; no publication-date limit). The outcome block reduced the exposure-only count from 164,628 by 77%. It retained all 21 screened relevant records, and neither 30-record loss sample contained an eligible record.

Relative recall was 100% on both the 15-record development set and the 6-record held-out set. Treat those figures cautiously: the records came from the same pilot discovery process, so the validation set is only semi-independent. The query also exceeds the 10,000-record workload budget.

The required internal critique could not be completed after the disk filled. My attempt to stage the request log to make room was blocked by automatic review, so I stopped that cleanup.
